name: gemini
competence: Very large context sweeps: reading, summarising or auditing big files or whole directories in a single pass
weaknesses: less reliable at long multi-step edit loops
weaker agentic tool discipline than peers

unattended.note: auto-approves every tool, not just edits

sandbox.note: the sheet's /sandbox is the interactive form; -s is the headless flag, confirmed against --help

plan.prompt_prefix: Think step-by-step. Work out the structure -- which files to create, what each is responsible for, and the interfaces between them -- then implement it. Task:

parallel.prompt_prefix: Spawn parallel verification steps across the affected files rather than one serial pass, then reconcile. Task:

no_op.prompt_prefix: Your previous run described this work instead of doing it. Do not restate the plan -- make the edits on disk now, and finish by listing the files you changed. Task:
no_op.note: re-dispatch with an explicit apply-the-edits instruction

stuck.prompt_prefix: You are running headless: nobody can answer a question, and asking one ends the run with nothing done. Make reasonable assumptions, complete the task, and record those assumptions in your final message. Task:
stuck.note: `/reset` is a session command and `-p` already starts a fresh session every run, so there is no stale history to clear -- the fix here is telling it not to ask, not resetting it

failed.prompt_prefix: A previous attempt at this task errored out. Inspect the working tree for half-applied changes, clean them up, then complete the task. Task:
failed.note: re-dispatch after checking the tree for partial work
